title: DTN: legacy buffer API (dtn.c) uses non-wrap-safe expiry comparison
description: Follow-up from jlfg review pass 1. lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/dtn.c:118 and :308 use unsafe 'expiry_unix <= now_unix' unsigned comparisons while the router gate and lichen_router_dtn_expire now use the wrap-safe signed-diff form. Align dtn.c for the year-2106 uint32 wrap consistency. Discovered during the jlfg review; not a defect in the jlfg change itself.
